DJIA Market Happenings For Wednesday, January 23, 2019 Posted by admin on January 23rd, 2019
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +153 points.
Tuesday the Dow was down -301.87 (-1.22%) at 24,404.48.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +4.62%.
There were 4 Dow stocks up Tuesday.
The Dow stock winners Tuesday were led by McDonald’s (MCD) +1.10%, Nike (NKE) +0.37% and Coca Cola (KO) +0.23%.
The Dow stock losers Tuesday were led by Caterpillar (CAT) -3.19%, DowDuPont (DWDP) -3.13% and United Technologies (UTX) -2.49%.
European stocks are mostly higher and Asian markets ended mostly lower.
The national average price of gasoline is up 1.7 cents at $2.269 per gallon.
